Package io.webagent4j.observation

Class ObservationEngine

java.lang.Object
io.webagent4j.observation.ObservationEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
IObservationEngine
public final class ObservationEngine extends Object implements IObservationEngine
Default deterministic semantic observation engine.

The engine is immutable and retains no per-observation mutable state. Concurrent sharing is safe only when the injected clock, identifier supplier, policies, factories, resolvers, and listener are themselves safe for concurrent use. It orchestrates one backend batch snapshot and focused semantic observers, and does not retain pages or live elements between calls.
